 Rogers has impressed since his move from Aston Villa published at 13:47 GMT 13:47 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-0 Manchester United 
 Nizaar Kinsella 
BBC Sport Chelsea reporter 
 Six goals and four assists for Morgan Rogers since joining Chelsea in the summer.His 10 goal involvements in 13 matches across all competitions is an impressive return, and no Chelsea player has played more minutes during that period. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 427 142 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Team news - Guehi dropped by Man City published at 13:47 GMT 13:47 GMT 
 Man City v Brighton (15:00 GMT) 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at Etihad Stadium 
 There two sides meet for the second time in three days after Manchester City emerged victorious on penalties against Brighton in the Carabao Cup on Wednesday.
 Both teams have returned to full strength, with Erling Haaland starting up front for Enzo Maresca's side, but the Italian has dropped Marc Guehi to the bench after a recent run of poor form.
 Matheus Nunes has recovered from injury and returns to the starting line-up, with both Phil Foden and Rayan Cherki on the bench.
 Man City XI: Donnarumma, Nunes, Dias, Khusanov, Gvardiol, Bouaddi, Anderson, Fernandez, Ndiaye, Doku, Haaland.
 Brighton stayed up in Manchester in preparation for this game and have the big guns back in the starting line-up, including striker Charalampos Kostoulas and captain Lewis Dunk.
 Wednesday's goalscorers Malick Yalcouye and Georginio Rutter are both on the bench.
 Brighton XI: Verbruggen, Costinha, Vuskovic, Dunk, Boscagli, Andres, Gomez, Ayari, De Cuyper, Gross, Kostoulas.

BBC Sport Manchester United reporter at Stamford Bridge

 Can they respond?
